<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that matches the described forward reaction (chalcone cyclization to flavanone). Using the provided tool, we can search the template catalog by specifying the functional groups formed and broken, as well as the bonds formed and broken. This should return candidate templates with their IDs. Once we have a template ID, we can retrieve its SMARTS and map the reaction to get the mapped_rxn string. Finally, we will output the mapped_rxn and template_id in the required JSON format.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
